svg.aria-label: The model proposes, the code disposes. The model holds the conversation. Tested code makes every decision that matters. I build retrieval, agents, MCP servers, voice, automation and data pipelines with that one rule at the center. The flagships ship deterministic test suites that need no API key and show captured output from real runs, and every README is honest about the trade-offs. My client work is under NDA and stays private; these public projects are built to the same standard. Open to freelance and contract work: vinimabreu.dev.
